spl_product_data_elements: FOOTSPA PEDI ALCOHOL WATER POLYSORBATE 20 MENTHOL FD&C BLUE NO. 1 CAMPHOR (SYNTHETIC) ALCOHOL ALCOHOL PEPPERMINT OIL EUCALYPTUS OIL D&C YELLOW NO. 11 DMDM HYDANTOIN
indications_and_usage: USES: To decrease bacteria on the skin.
warnings: • For external use only. • Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membrane. • Do not apply to wounds or damaged skin with a heating pad or on a child under 12 year of age.
other_safety_information: FLAMMABLE: Keep away from fire or flame.
ask_doctor: ASK A DOCTOR BEFORE USE IF If you have redness over affected area.
stop_use: Condition persists for more than 72 hours.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: If swallowed, get medical help, or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS: Adults and children 12 years of age or older • Spray two to three pumps or as necessary to cover the affected area not more than three to four times daily.
inactive_ingredient: Water (Aqua), Camphor, Polysorbate 20, Menthol, DMDM Hydantoin, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil, D&C Yellow No.11(CI 47000), FD&C Blue No.1 (CI 42090).
